name: Agent Configuration & Prompt Logic Tampering
description: Persistent modification of what governs the agent — system prompt assembly, tool registry, agent configuration files or deployment settings — so the compromise survives the session without a new injection.
differs: Distinguished from Persistent Memory Poisoning (T2.002), which corrupts remembered content: here the executable configuration itself is rewritten.
